recruitment_period: February 2010 to January 2015 (Phase 1: February 2010-March 2014; Phase 2: January 2013-January 2015)
prophylaxis_detail: Posaconazole, itraconazole, echinocandins, voriconazole, amphotericin B; prophylaxis status (prior use of prophylaxis) included as covariate in adjusted analyses; prophylaxis data available for only a subset (e.g., 99 of Phase 2 subjects; overall prophylaxis data for 87 of 188 extension patients)
adjustment_covariates: age, sex, country of origin, allo-HSCT status, antifungal prophylaxis status (Table 3); age, sex, country of origin, severe neutropenia, prophylactic status (Table 4, allo-HSCT-stratified analysis)

overlapping_cohort_suspected: The Phase 1 cohort (n=593) is a subset fully contained within the Overall cohort (n=781); the allo-HSCT-stratified analysis (n=171) overlaps with both of the above as a subgroup using donor genotypes.

title: Dectin-1 rs3901533 and rs7309123 Polymorphisms Increase Susceptibility to Pulmonary Invasive Fungal Disease in Patients with Acute Myeloid Leukemia from a  Chinese Han Population.
source_pdf_filename: Chen et al. - 2019 - Dectin-1 rs3901533 and rs7309123 Polymorphisms Increase Susceptibility to Pulmonary Invasive Fungal.pdf
hwe_violations: none (all eight SNPs were in Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium)

overlapping_cohort_suspected: Single-center Chinese cohort; no indication of overlap with other published cohorts in this paper.

title: Polymorphisms within the ARNT2 and CX3CR1 Genes Are Associated with the Risk of Developing Invasive Aspergillosis.
source_pdf_filename: Lupiañez et al. - 2020 - Polymorphisms within the ARNT2 and CX3CR1 Genes Are Associated with the Risk of Developing Invasive.pdf
country: Spain, Germany, Austria, Italy (discovery and replication cohorts); Belgium (BAL specimens for functional sub-study only)
prophylaxis_detail: Prophylaxis status recorded as 'ever received prophylaxis' (yes/no); available for 400/500 discovery subjects and 285/474 replication subjects; IA was less frequent among prophylaxed patients (P=0.003 overall); used as an additional adjustment covariate in a sensitivity analysis for the discovery cohort, where the CX3CR1 rs7631529 and rs9823718 associations remained significant; specific drugs/doses not detailed.
hwe_violations: None reported; all SNPs were in Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium in the non-IA (control) group (P>0.05).
adjustment_covariates: age, sex, allo-SCT status, country of origin (primary models); antifungal prophylaxis status added in a secondary sensitivity analysis for the discovery population
funding_source: Fondo de Investigaciones Sanitarias (Spain, grants PI12/02688 and PI17/02276); ERA-NET PathoGenoMics (PIM2010EPA-00756, grant 0315900A); Collaborative Research Center/Transregio 124 FungiNet; Northern Portugal Regional Operational Program/NORTE 2020 (FEDER grant NORTE-01-0145-FEDER-000013); Fundação para a Ciência e Tecnologia (FCT, grants IF/00735/2014 and SFRH/BPD/96176/2013); Astellas Pharma Inc.; private donation from an AML survivor. overlapping_cohort_suspected: Likely partial overlap with other AspBIOmics consortium publications; the discovery cohort was recruited through the AspBIOmics consortium (www.aspbiomics.eu) and the replication cohort was recruited from Spanish (Virgen de las Nieves) and Italian (Rome, Modena) centers 'as described elsewhere (ref. 56)', referring to Lupianez et al. 2015 Infect Immun, which used an overlapping AspBIOmics-derived hematology cohort for a different panel of immunity genes.

prophylaxis_detail: Prophylaxis status available in 677/911 patients (376 discovery, 301 replication); use of antifungal prophylaxis was less frequent among IA patients than non-IA patients (53.85% vs 66.79%, p = 0.008); authors note the multicenter nature made it impossible to adjust the genetic association analysis for antifungal prophylaxis.

funding_source: Fondo de Investigaciones Sanitarias (PI20/01845, PI12/02688, ISCIII-FEDER PI17/02276); ERA-NET PathoGenoMics (PIM2010EPA-00756); Collaborative Research Center/Transregio 124 FungiNet; Fundação para a Ciência e Tecnologia (FCT) (PTDC/SAU-SER/29635/2017, PTDC/MED-GEN/28778/2017, CEECIND/03628/2017, CEECIND/04058/2018); European Union's Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme grant agreement no. 847507; 'la Caixa' Foundation (ID 100010434) and FCT agreement LCF/PR/HP17/52190003.
risk_of_bias_notes: Multicenter study (Spain, Germany, Austria, Italy for the genetic cohorts; additional Netherlands/Portugal sites for functional studies only) with a two-stage discovery (n=423) and replication (n=488) design and fixed-effect meta-analysis; patients with 'possible' IA (unreliable diagnosis) were excluded; genetic association analysis could not be adjusted for antifungal prophylaxis due to incomplete clinical data collection across centers; SNPs genotyped were tagging SNPs selected based on predicted biological function (RegulomeDB, GTEx, blood eQTL browser), not an unbiased genome-wide set; functional/mechanistic follow-up (cytokine, proteomic, cell count, fungicidal assays) performed in a separate HFGP healthy-donor cohort, not in the IA patients themselves.

risk_of_bias_notes: Retrospective chart review-based IA phenotyping with central adjudication; retrospective GM testing on banked samples used to reduce diagnostic bias/missed cases over the long study period; no correction for multiple comparisons across 20 SNPs x 24 genetic/endpoint combinations (Bonferroni threshold would be P<.0001 but P<=.05 used); exploratory analyses (different genotype source, genetic model, timepoint, or SGM+ endpoint) not considered strict replication; only white patients included (9% nonwhite excluded); authors note they removed patients overlapping with a prior cohort (Bochud 2008) for the TLR4 SNP comparison, indicating awareness of cohort overlap in general literature base. [Round-2 extraction note] Of 25 candidate SNPs, 5 failed quality control and were not analysed: TNFR1 rs767455 (low posterior probability), TLR1 rs4833095 (HWE), CLEC7A rs3901533, CD209 rs4804800 and CD209 rs7252229 (low call rate). No rows emitted for those. rs1840680 is recorded as an LD proxy label for the PTX3 result and has no row of its own (see note on the rs2305619 Table 3 row). supplemental Table 1 (all 20 analysed SNPs) is referenced but not reproduced in the available text, so no genotype counts or null estimates could be captured for SNPs absent from Tables 3-4.
overlapping_cohort_suspected: Yes - authors explicitly state they removed patients who were included in both this cohort and a prior published cohort (Bochud et al. TLR4 study) to avoid overlap, confirming partial overlap existed with at least one previously published validation cohort.

prophylaxis_detail: Prophylaxis based on triazoles (fluconazole, itraconazole) as primary prevention, stopped at 75 days after HSCT if no IFD developed; Table 1 reports Fluconazole 9 (3.6%), Itraconazole 181 (72.1%), Voriconazole 53 (21.1%), Caspofungin 8 (3.2%).

risk_of_bias_notes: Only 22 IFD events (small numbers, wide/unstable CIs e.g. HR 1.933 [0.010-366.116], 3.646 [0-1467], 0.045 [0-1806]); univariate screening threshold p<0.1 used for multivariate entry across 43 SNPs x2 (recipient/donor) with no stated correction for multiple comparisons; study cites 'EORTC/MSG 2019' criteria, which does not map exactly to the 2008/2002 schema options; single-center; fungal etiology identified in only 8/22 IFD cases; recipient and donor genotype groupings combine both homozygote classes (AA and GG) together as 'homozygous' vs heterozygous 'GA', precluding identification of a single effect allele.
